The researchers found that discussions around chemtrails dominated the discourse, with a notable spike in tweets coinciding with the Harvard SCoPEx project launch in April 2017, peaking at around 8,000 tweets. Notably, funding for solar geoengineering research, including support from the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation, does not imply a secretive spraying program. The study also noted that from 2018 to 2021, conversations surrounding chemtrails became more toxic and broader in scope, while legitimate environmental issues received less attention.
